metadata.question: Was nightime brightness around the Aswan High Dam higher than the Grand Ethopian Renaissance Dam in 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use VIIRS Nighttime Lights data (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG) - Date: 2016 (full year or specific months) - Locations: * Aswan High Dam, Egypt: approximately (24.0, 32.9) * Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam (GERD), Ethiopia: approximately (11.2, 35.1) - Need to create buffer zones around each dam to measure nighttime brightness 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights data - Will use the 'avg_rad' band (average radiance) - May need to filter out low quality data if available 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: A dam might legitimately have zero nighttime brightness - Need to check if images exist (C1) - Need to check if valid pixels exist after processing (C2) - Need to verify results are valid numbers, not None/NaN (C3) - Compare mean brightness values between the two locations ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define locations and buffers const aswanDam = ee.Geometry.Point([32.9, 24.0]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer const gerdDam = ee.Geometry.Point([35.1, 11.2]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer // 2. Load VIIRS Nighttime Lights data for 2016 const nightLights = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31'); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = nightLights.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images in 2016: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log('No nighttime lights data found for 2016.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Calculate mean composite for the year const composite = nightLights.select('avg_rad').mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics for Aswan Dam const aswanStats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: aswanDam, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const aswanBrightness = aswanStats['avg_rad_mean']; const aswanCount = aswanStats['avg_rad_count']; console.log(`Aswan Dam - Brightness: ${aswanBrightness}, Pixels: ${aswanCount}`); // 5. Calculate statistics for GERD const gerdStats = composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: gerdDam, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const gerdBrightness = gerdStats['avg_rad_mean']; const gerdCount = gerdStats['avg_rad_count']; console.log(`GERD - Brightness: ${gerdBrightness}, Pixels: ${gerdCount}`); // 6. Validation and final answer if (aswanCount === 0 || gerdCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels found for one or both locations.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (aswanBrightness === null || aswanBrightness === undefined || gerdBrightness === null || gerdBrightness === undefined || isNaN(aswanBrightness) || isNaN(gerdBrightness)) { console.log('Invalid calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare brightness values console.log(`Comparison: Aswan (${aswanBrightness.toFixed(3)}) vs GERD (${gerdBrightness.toFixed(3)})`); if (aswanBrightness > gerdBrightness) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
